posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I have a plugin that seems like it does what you want, but I haven't tested it in MZ (it was written for MV). Here's the documentation section:
Spoiler
Code:
With this plugin you can make a skill that can be used with more than two types
of weapon, or one that works with any type except for a few specified, or one
that requires the user to have no weapon, or one that only works with a shield.

You cannot mix required weapons and forbidden weapons. If you do, the required
ones take priority and forbidden ones are ignored.

You can however mix required and forbidden equipment slots.

Note Tags
=========

<requireUnarmed> (skills)
  You must be unarmed to use this skill.
  If required weapon types are set in the editor, you can also use the skill
  with either of those weapons.

<requireWeapons:1,2> (skills)
  The skill can be used with the given weapon types.
  If you need more than 2 required weapons, use this.
  It supplements the required weapons set by dropdown and works the same way.

<requireEquip:2> (skills)
  The skill cannot be used unless you have an item equipped in the specified
  slot.
  A dual-wielding character cannot use this skill if slot 2 is specified.
  A slot of 1 is ignored; use <forbidUnarmed> instead.

<forbidUnarmed> (skills)
  You cannot use this skill while unarmed.
  Useful for attacks that can be used with any weapon but do require a weapon.

<forbidWeapons:1,2> (skills)
  The skill cannot be used with the specified weapon types.

<forbidEquip:2> (skills)
  This skill cannot be used if you have an item equipped in the specified
  slot.
  A slot of 1 is ignored; use <requireUnarmed> instead.
Does that look like what you need? If so, I could clean it up, test to see if it works in MZ, tweak it a little if it doesn't, and post the full plugin.
